availability_assumption: Released demographic variables represent information collected before the MEC depression interview. Real-time availability of the processed income-to-poverty ratio is not established.

coding.RIDAGEYR: Preserve released coding; 80 represents age 80 or older.
coding.RIAGENDR: Preserve source definition and released codes.
coding.INDFMPIR: Preserve released ratio; 5 is the topcoded category.

income_missingness.indicator: Create from original missingness before imputation.
income_missingness.imputation: Median of observed income in each training partition.
income_missingness.heldout_application: Use only the corresponding training median.

outcome_missingness.policy: Retain the existing complete-outcome cohort definition.

secondary_comparison.purpose: Assess dependence on including income and its missingness indicator.
requirements: Same eligible cohort and folds as the primary analysis
Same estimator specification and evaluation rules
No post-hoc promotion based on held-out performance

supporting_audit.meaning: Predictor validity and fold income availability checks passed.
supporting_audit.limitation: Does not establish clinical utility or eliminate missing-data bias.
